title: Make mapLimit() respect its concurrency limit
prompt: src/mapLimit.js exports async mapLimit(items, limit, fn): it should call fn(item, index) for every item with at most `limit` calls in flight at once, and resolve with the results in the original order. It currently ignores the limit. Reject with a RangeError if limit is not a positive integer, and reject with fn's error if any call fails.
acceptance: mapLimit() never has more than `limit` calls in flight and does use the limit [tests: never exceeds the concurrency limit, limit 1 is sequential]
results are returned in the original order [tests: preserves result order, empty input resolves]
rejects with fn's error if any call fails [tests: rejects with the failing call error]
rejects with RangeError if limit is not a positive integer [tests: rejects an invalid limit]
